storagePrimitiveDecision.existingGap: evidence.Open probes HeadBucket and cannot be used as shipped source-worker startup authority.
storagePrimitiveDecision.existingSafeRead: evidence.OpenReader performs no construction I/O and verifies scope/size/SHA256.
storagePrimitiveDecision.existingNoProbePublicationPath: app.openReportStore/put/read uses explicit configuration, bounded hashed publication and the existing evidence reader without a bucket probe.
storagePrimitiveDecision.parentChoice: Reuse/factor the existing safe app path, or expose a narrow no-probe writer constructor around existing evidence internals. No test-side writer shim or broad-permission fallback.
storagePrimitiveDecision.testRestriction: Core evidence tap is read-only; worker tap allows only selected-prefix object operations. Neither accepts HeadBucket/ListBucket.

credentialDomain.envelope: version byte 1 || fresh 12-byte nonce || AES-256-GCM ciphertext/tag

collectionSemantics.rawRecordStorage: exact S3 bytes; bounded PG metadata/ref/digest only
collectionSemantics.retries: terminal partial/failed/blocked; new explicit manual request, no hidden retry/backoff

ownedIntegrityNegative: A test-created S3 object alone is overwritten via real local S3 to verify trusted digest rejection; no PG business/ref/lease/actor row is mutated.
